Mode.Name: Mobile Mode
Mode.Hint: Choose when VE Mobile takes over Foundry in this browser. Changing this setting reloads Foundry.

Theme.Name: Theme
Theme.Hint: Choose VE Mobile's colour mode. This also changes Foundry's Interface and Application themes. Changing Foundry's Interface Theme updates this setting.

ColourScheme.Name: Colour Scheme
ColourScheme.Hint: Choose the colours used in VE Mobile. Based on class uses a character's class; Neutral is used for player-owned NPCs, and Bestiary for other NPCs.

ProtectVeStyling.Name: Protect VE styling
ProtectVeStyling.Hint: Keep VE Mobile's layout and appearance when another module's styles conflict. Other modules still work, and their own windows keep their styles. Turn this off to let other modules style VE Mobile screens.

HeaderArtworkOpacity.Name: Header artwork opacity
HeaderArtworkOpacity.Hint: Set how strongly the chosen artwork appears behind the Character header.

QuickbarEnabled.Name: Show action bar
QuickbarEnabled.Hint: Show your chosen action bar over the Scene. Its slots adjust to the available space.

QuickbarRows.Name: Quickbar rows
QuickbarRows.Hint: Choose whether the Scene action bar has one or two rows of character shortcuts.

QuickbarSource.Name: Action bar source
QuickbarSource.Hint: Choose shortcuts from the current character or macros from your Foundry Hotbar.

ShowActionSummaries.Name: Show action summaries
ShowActionSummaries.Hint: Show a summary after using an item, spell, or feature. Turning this off does not affect rolls or chat messages.

CompactActionSummaries.Name: Compact action summaries
CompactActionSummaries.Hint: When action summaries are on, make them smaller. Actions without a roll do not open a compact card.

GraphicsSafety.Name: Animated effect safety
GraphicsSafety.Hint: Control animated video effects to help avoid graphics memory problems. Auto leaves capable devices unchanged, limits effects on mid-range Android devices, and uses still images on Apple or other constrained devices.

DiceRendering.Name: Mobile 3D dice safety
DiceRendering.Hint: Choose how VE Mobile handles animated 3D dice. Auto adjusts to the device and graphics recovery; Static turns off dice animation; Reduced lowers the work needed to draw dice; Unchanged follows Dice So Nice and Foundry settings.

MobileOptimizedAssets.Name: Mobile Optimised Assets
MobileOptimizedAssets.Hint: Use verified image copies prepared for mobile before Foundry loads Scene images. Auto follows this device's capabilities, whether VE Mobile is in Phone, Tablet, or Desktop mode.

MemoryProtectionProfile.Name: Memory Protection Profile
MemoryProtectionProfile.Hint: Choose how strongly VE Mobile reduces graphics work in the active Scene. No profile can guarantee that every Scene will fit in this browser's memory.

MemoryProtectionBehavior.Name: Memory Protection Behavior
MemoryProtectionBehavior.Hint: Recommend asks before applying a stronger profile. Automatic applies a stronger profile when needed. Off never changes the profile automatically; Scene Memory Warnings controls whether a prompt appears.

AfterGraphicsFailure.Name: After graphics failure
AfterGraphicsFailure.Hint: Choose what VE Mobile should do the next time it can recover after the browser's graphics system fails.

SceneMemoryWarnings.Name: Scene Memory Warnings
SceneMemoryWarnings.Hint: Warn before opening a Scene you choose when its images are estimated to use a lot of memory.

AssetOptimizer.MenuHint: Scan Scene images and make mobile copies that use less memory.

MovementRepeatDelay.Name: Repeated movement interval
MovementRepeatDelay.Hint: Set the time between repeated joystick steps, up to one second. At zero, the next step starts as soon as the previous one safely finishes.

RecenterAfterMove.Name: Recentre after every move
RecenterAfterMove.Hint: Keep the token you control centred on screen after each joystick step.

JoystickSide.Name: Joystick side
JoystickSide.Hint: Choose the left or right edge of the Scene, or let the layout pick the clearer side. On tablets, Follow layout places it opposite the navigation and content panels.

CombatCarousel.Name: Combat carousel
CombatCarousel.Hint: Show the combat carousel over the Scene during combat.

KeepScreenAwake.Name: Keep screen awake
KeepScreenAwake.Hint: Ask this browser to keep the screen on while VE Mobile is active. Your browser must support this feature.
KeepScreenAwake.Unsupported: Screen Wake Lock is unavailable in this browser.
KeepScreenAwake.Failure: The browser refused the screen wake lock. Check Low Power Mode and browser permissions, then try again.

CharacterFavouritesSource.Name: Character favourites source
CharacterFavouritesSource.Hint: Choose which favourites list VE Mobile uses. When Tidy5e is active, its bookmarks use D&D5e's favourites, so Tidy and Both may show the same list.

LoggingLevel.Name: Diagnostic logging
LoggingLevel.Hint: Choose how much detail VE Mobile records for a support report. Saving reports to the GM-only journal is a separate setting.

SaveDiagnosticsToJournal.Name: Save diagnostics to VE Diagnostics Journal
SaveDiagnosticsToJournal.Hint: While Phone or Tablet is active and a GM is online, saves recent events in batches at most every 45 seconds; may also save before leaving mobile mode. Includes versions, browser family, session identifiers, settings and event categories, without chat text or character data. Only GMs can access the report.

DisableCanvas.Name: Disable game canvas
DisableCanvas.Hint: Turn off Foundry's Scene canvas to reduce graphics work and battery use. The Scene tab will be unavailable after Foundry reloads.

FoundryPerformance.Name: Foundry Performance Mode
FoundryPerformance.Hint: Choose Foundry's rendering quality. This can also change graphics used by modules such as Dice So Nice.
FoundryPerformance.Unsupported: Foundry's performance setting is unavailable until the game has fully started.

Controls.Title: Controls & Gestures
Controls.Invitation: Get to know the mobile controls
Controls.MenuHint: Review mobile controls at any time, including from Desktop.

Entries.Tap: Tap a button or row to perform its labelled action. Gestures depend on the surface you touch.
Entries.Hold: Hold still to reveal available actions. Item and effect menus can open while you are holding; token and portrait controls wait for release. Moving early usually scrolls or pans.
Entries.Back: Back or Escape closes the topmost surface first. Use the visible Close or Cancel button when a placement asks for a decision.
Entries.Availability: Available actions depend on the object, Scene configuration and your permissions. A control cannot grant permission to act.
Entries.Pan: Drag with one finger to pan the Scene. Pinch with two fingers to zoom. Begin outside buttons and overlays.
Entries.Select: Tap a token you control to select it. Another ordinary tap keeps it selected; it is not the same as a timed double tap. Tap a token whose controls are open to close those controls.
Entries.Target: Quickly tap the same visible token twice to toggle targeting. The taps must be close together in time and position; this does not open its sheet.
Entries.TokenHold: Hold a token you control without moving, then release to open its native controls.
Entries.TokenDrag: To move an existing token, hold it still first, then drag after the hold activates. Moving before the hold activates pans the Scene. Native movement, walls and pause rules still apply.
Entries.Scenery: Tap interactive scenery for its configured click action. Hold still and release for its configured secondary action. Some scenery also responds to quick repeated taps. Only configured, available interactions work; scenery is not universally draggable.
Entries.Joystick: Select a token, then push the joystick in a direction. Keep holding to repeat movement; release to stop. A short tap on its centre releases token control. Use the movement selector for available tokens and movement options.
Entries.NoCanvas: The live map is disabled in this browser. Character, chat, journals and Help remain available; map gestures and placement need the game canvas.
Entries.Portrait: Tap the portrait to view its image.
Entries.Chooser: Tap the character name to open the Actor chooser, then tap an available row to select it. Scroll the list to find another Actor.
Entries.Rows: Tap item, spell and feature rows to view their details. Hold a row for its available action menu. Choose Use or a roll explicitly; available menu actions vary.
Entries.Members: Tap an available Group member to open their character. Back returns to the Group and restores the previous tab and scroll position.
Entries.Quickbar: Tap a populated Character Quickbar slot to use its shortcut. Hold a slot to edit; choose slots or drag between them to arrange shortcuts. Save keeps the arrangement; Cancel discards the staged edits.
Entries.Hotbar: Tap a populated Foundry Hotbar slot to run its macro. Hold a slot to open editing tools. Assign, replace and remove macros with those explicit tools.
Entries.Navigation: Use the navigation buttons to change screens. Back closes menus and details before returning to the previous character or pane.
Entries.Preview: When an action opens a token or measured-template preview, position it on the Scene and adjust the available controls. Place confirms; Cancel ends placement. Opening a preview alone does not place it.
Entries.ActorPlace: For an eligible character, hold its portrait or chooser row still and release, then choose Place on Scene. Position the new-token preview and use Place or Cancel.
Entries.SplitDrop: In Tablet Split, hold an eligible character portrait or chooser row until the preview appears, then drag onto the Scene pane and release to create a new token directly. A valid Split drop does not wait for a Place button. Releasing outside the Scene cancels.
Entries.DesktopReview: You are reviewing mobile controls from Desktop. Mobile Mode in Foundry settings enables or selects the Phone or Tablet presentation for this browser and reloads Foundry.
Entries.Phone: Phone shows one screen at a time. Actor placement uses a staged preview with Place and Cancel.
Entries.TabletSplit: Tablet Split shows content beside the Scene in landscape. Use the side control to move the dock. Split portrait drops create tokens directly; native action previews still use Place and Cancel.
Entries.TabletFull: Tablet Full shows the selected screen across the available space. Use Split Screen to return to side-by-side content when landscape and the live map are available.
